svg.aria-label: How a transaction dollar flows through Visa — and where Visa's $40B net revenue pools
svg.text: How a transaction dollar flows through Visa — and where Visa's
Cardholders spend, merchants and their acquirers pay fees, Visa takes a thin per-transaction slice across $17T of volume — then
routes ~39% of gross revenue back to issuing banks as client incentives. The money pools at the issuers; Visa keeps the toll.
money embedded in a finished chip
FOLLOW THE MONEY — VISA KEEPS THE TOLL, THE BANKS KEEP THE POOL
Source: Visa FY2025 10-K (Statements of Operations, Note 1 revenue, Cash Flows) + Q2 FY26 release
